login.feature1Text: Build the weekly roster in minutes, not hours.
login.feature2Text: Wage spend updates as you schedule.
login.feature3Text: Staff submit availability before each week.
login.heroSub: Build weekly rosters, track labour costs, and collect availability — all in one place.
login.welcomeSub: Sign in to manage your team's schedule.
login.agree: By signing in you agree to our <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
login.errorDefault: Something went wrong. Please try again.
login.errorExpiredLink: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Request a new one below.
login.errorAccountExists: This email is already linked to a different sign-in method. Use the one you signed up with.
login.errorBusy: We're at capacity right now. Please try again in a moment.

verifyPhone.title: Verify your phone
verifyPhone.intro: {orgName} needs a number they can reach you on. We'll text you a 6-digit code.
verifyPhone.codeIntro: We texted a 6-digit code to {phone}. Enter it to confirm your number.
verifyPhone.skipForNow: Skip for now — go to my schedule

join.codeIntro: We emailed a 6-digit code to {email}. Enter it to link your account.
join.linkedVerifyIntro: Your account is linked to {org}. Verify your phone so they can reach you about shifts.
join.linkedIntro: Your account is now linked to {org}.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We've sent you a sign-in link. Open it on this device to continue.
checkEmail.hint: The link works once. If it doesn't let you in, request a new one — some mail apps open links automatically.
